chronology: eval_memzero.py Generate_Single_Persona_Evaluation iterates the session chain in order, adds session i's dialogue, then answers session i's questions; the allowed history for a question is sessions 0..i inclusive

judge_omits_a_metric_key.upstream_behaviour: parse_llm_metric_result reads parsed_result.get(metric_key, 0), so a missing key scores zero

llm_judge_unavailable_or_raising.our_treatment: UNMEASURED, and the lane is named upstream_rule_fallback, never merged with upstream_llm_judge
llm_judge_unavailable_or_raising.upstream_behaviour: evaluate_question_with_llm catches every exception and returns None; Evaluate_Single_Question then falls back to build_rule_based_result, which leaves all white-box metrics at 0.0 although nothing was measured

missing_model_answer.upstream_behaviour: build_missing_answer_result returns every metric as 0.0 with Error_Tags=['missing_model_answer']

unparsable_support_rank.upstream_behaviour: parse_support_rank returns 0 on any parse failure, which reads as a miss

reader_status_in_gen36: requires_reader_authorization: no LLM, no external API, no GPU was used
white_box_support_decision: the judge is shown the top-K retrieved memory strings with their created_at values and returns a support rank; there is no released identifier in that decision, so upstream white-box scoring is semantic, not exact (eval_scoring.py build_llm_judge_prompt, parse_llm_metric_result, derive_white_box_metrics_from_rank)
